g.text: Title: V2 input-stage A1 - isolated candidate

g.desc: Title: V2 input-stage A1 - isolated candidate

g.text: Not integrated or approved for powered use

g.desc: Not integrated or approved for powered use

g.style: fill:#FFFFC2; fill-opacity:1.0000; stroke:none;

g.text: Replace both buck cells and raw-side sensing/ADC protection before powered bring-up. E-01 through E-06 remain open in live CAD.

g.desc: Replace both buck cells and raw-side sensing/ADC protection before powered bring-up. E-01 through E-06 remain open in live CAD.

g.text: D12 loss model: about 0.627 W at 1 A DC; copper area, cold drop, leakage and temperature still need qualification.

g.desc: D12 loss model: about 0.627 W at 1 A DC; copper area, cold drop, leakage and temperature still need qualification.

g.text: Original PCB, corrected ground copper, V1 behavior, IMU2 candidate and purchasing package remain unchanged.

g.desc: Original PCB, corrected ground copper, V1 behavior, IMU2 candidate and purchasing package remain unchanged.

g.text: ISOLATED CANDIDATE - do not power the retained legacy converter/sense circuits

g.desc: ISOLATED CANDIDATE - do not power the retained legacy converter/sense circuits

g.text: This sheet defines the input boundary only. Native connectivity checks do not qualify protection or assembly.

g.desc: This sheet defines the input boundary only. Native connectivity checks do not qualify protection or assembly.

g.text: Normal battery: 7-25.2 V; initial external-BEC variant: <=1 A board feed. ESC motor current bypasses this board.

g.desc: Normal battery: 7-25.2 V; initial external-BEC variant: <=1 A board feed. ESC motor current bypasses this board.

g.text: Qualification target: VBAT_FUSED within +/-44 V and stored VIN_RAW <=44 V. These are required bounds, not measured results.

g.desc: Qualification target: VBAT_FUSED within +/-44 V and stored VIN_RAW <=44 V. These are required bounds, not measured results.

g.text: At those bounds D12 blocks at most 88 V against 100 V rating. Do not infer an unlimited surge rating from the TVS value.

g.desc: At those bounds D12 blocks at most 88 V against 100 V rating. Do not infer an unlimited surge rating from the TVS value.

g.text: F1 is not a 1 A limiter. Verify inrush, source short-circuit current, fuse interrupt conditions and TVS/fuse energy coordination.

g.desc: F1 is not a 1 A limiter. Verify inrush, source short-circuit current, fuse interrupt conditions and TVS/fuse energy coordination.

g.text: C1/C2 values are candidate selections. Check ripple, effective capacitance, polarity, physical lands and discharged-output reversal.

g.desc: C1/C2 values are candidate selections. Check ripple, effective capacitance, polarity, physical lands and discharged-output reversal.
